
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19189573" title="发布于 2025-11-04 11:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ASP.NET Core Blazor 核心功能二：Blazor表单和验证</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p>大家好，我是码农刚子。本文介绍了Blazor中EditForm组件的使用及表单验证方案。主要内容包括：</p>
<p>1）EditForm基础用法，通过Model参数绑定模型，使用DataAnnotationsValidator实现数据注解验证；</p>
<p>2）自定义验证规则实现，通过继承ComponentBase创建CustomValidator组件，结合ValidationMessageStore管理验证消息；</p>
<p>3）集成第三方验证库FluentValidation，展示如何定义复杂业务规则验证。文章提供了完整代码示例，涵盖内置验证、自定义验证和第三方验证三种方案，帮助开发者灵活处理Blazor表单验证需求。</p>
<h2 id="JsWvb"><span class="ne-text">一、<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">EditForm</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件使用</span></span></h2>
<p id="ub5c67550" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Blazor 的 EditForm 是一个强大的组件，用于处理表单输入和验证。它通过绑定模型和验证逻辑，简化了表单的开发过程。以下是 EditForm 的核心功能和使用示例。</span></p>
<h3 id="V5lS1"><span class="ne-text">Blazor 表单内置组件</span></h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1466017/202511/1466017-20251104110708751-65012039.png" alt="67b1af17adffb47f738b8efbc8f1fc12" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="KYHMT"><span class="ne-text">基本功能</span></h3>
<p id="u0adc286d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">EditForm 组件通过 Model 参数绑定到一个模型实例，并使用 <strong>DataAnnotationsValidator</strong><span class="ne-text"> 组件支持基于数据注释的验证。它提供了以下事件回调：</span></span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ucf3db8d8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">OnValidSubmit<span class="ne-text">：当表单验证通过时触发。</span></span></li>
<li id="uf8be79f0" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">OnInvalidSubmit<span class="ne-text">：当表单验证失败时触发。</span></span></li>
<li id="ueb70423d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">OnSubmit：无论验证状态如何，都会触发。</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u2415985b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">以下是一个简单的表单示例：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/formsample</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
</span>&lt;h3&gt;表单&lt;/h3&gt;
&lt;p&gt;@stu.ToString()&lt;/p&gt;

&lt;EditForm Model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@stu</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> OnValidSubmit=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">onValidSubmit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> OnInvalidSubmit=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">onInvalidSubmit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;

    &lt;DataAnnotationsValidator&gt;&lt;/DataAnnotationsValidator&gt;
    &lt;ValidationSummary&gt;&lt;/ValidationSummary&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-inline</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        姓名：</span>&lt;InputText @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stu.name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/InputText&gt;
        &lt;ValidationMessage For=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">() =&gt; stu.name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-inline</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        年龄：</span>&lt;InputNumber @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stu.age</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/InputNumber&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-inline</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        生日：</span>&lt;InputDate @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stu.birthday</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/InputDate&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-inline</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        是否婚配：  </span>&lt;InputCheckbox @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stu.ismarried</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;&lt;/InputCheckbox&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-inline</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        现居城市：
        </span>&lt;InputSelect @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">stu.city</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
            &lt;option value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">北京</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;北京&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">上海</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;上海&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">广州</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;广州&lt;/option&gt;
            &lt;option value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">深圳</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;深圳&lt;/option&gt;
        &lt;/InputSelect&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">submit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;Submit&lt;/button&gt;

&lt;/EditForm&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">


@code {

    {

        [Required]
        [StringLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, ErrorMessage = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">名字最大长度不能超过10位</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> ismarried { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">是否婚配</span>

        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">on onValidSubmit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> onInvalidSubmit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

    }

}</span></pre>

<div class="lake-content">
<p id="ua8b5ff64" class="ne-p"><strong>验证与错误处理</strong></p>
<p id="uc91e0bea" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">通过 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ValidationSummary</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件可以显示所有验证错误，而 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ValidationMessage</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件可以针对特定字段显示错误信息。数据注释如 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">[Required]</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 和 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">[StringLength]</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 用于定义验证规则。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="ubaa8158e" class="ne-p"><strong><span class="ne-text">EditForm 提供了一系列数据验证的属性/方法，这样我们不用自己再去实现了。</span></strong></p>
<table id="e6ZCg" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="u6825993e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">属性<span class="ne-text">/<span class="ne-text">方法<span class="ne-text">名</span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="ueb904279" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">说明</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="u19aba833" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Modal</span></p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="u8df25b14" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">表单实体模型，必填</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="u7d0dfdf2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">OnValidSubmit/OnInvalidSubmit</span></p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="u8e8fef9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">提交表单时，验证通过<span class="ne-text">/<span class="ne-text">未通过 的回调函数</span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="uf68f62af" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">OnSubmit</span></p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="u56039e65" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">提交表单时的回调函数，和上面的两个属于“或”的关系，</span></p>
<p id="u467d0e81" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">使用了<span class="ne-text">OnValidSubmit/OnInvalidSubmit<span class="ne-text">就不能再使用<span class="ne-text">OnSubmit<span class="ne-text">。同理，使用了<span class="ne-text">OnSubmit<span class="ne-text">就不能使用<span class="ne-text">OnValidSubmit/OnInvalidSubmit<span class="ne-text">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="uecf29a96" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">OnSubmit<span class="ne-text">可以用来做一些自定义的验证</span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="u9c3918f9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">DataAnnotationsValidator</span></p>
<p id="u30b221d3" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="u128fc8bb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">启用数据注解验证，就是特性验证。</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="262">
<p id="u6e4cd706" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">ValidationSummary</span></p>
</td>
<td width="482">
<p id="uce81f598" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">验证结果摘要。验证不合法时，会在表单的顶部用<span class="ne-text">html<span class="ne-text">标签显示具体错误。也是继承自<span class="ne-text">ComponentBase<span class="ne-text">的一种组件</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="G3R9l"><span class="ne-text">二、自定义验证规则</span></h2>
<h3 id="GpGMW"><span class="ne-text">自定义 ValidationMessageStore</span></h3>
<p id="u2a51a1ad" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">如果需要更复杂的校验逻辑，可以使用<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">ValidationMessageStore<span class="ne-text"> <span class="ne-text">手动管理验证消息。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p id="ub5b76b1c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们来自定义一个验证组件：</span></p>
<p id="u51a09a92" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">关于验证的组件思路，我们首先肯定是要从ComponentBase组件来集成，然后我们上面有学习到&lt;EditForm&gt;会定义一个级联值，我们自定义的组件也是嵌入到EditForm中，因此我们需要定义级联参数从而引用该值，我们先放代码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BlazorApp
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomValidator:ComponentBase
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValidationMessageStore messageStore;
        [CascadingParameter]
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> EditContext currentEditContext { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnInitialized()
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (currentEditContext == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{nameof(CustomValidator)} requires a cascading </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">parameter of type {nameof(EditContext)}. For example, you can use {nameof(CustomValidator)} </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                    $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">inside an EditForm.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
            messageStore </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValidationMessageStore(currentEditContext);
            currentEditContext.OnValidationRequested </span>+= (s, e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> messageStore.Clear();
            currentEditContext.OnFieldChanged </span>+= (s, e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> messageStore.Clear(e.FieldIdentifier);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> DisplayErrors(Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> errors) 
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> error <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> errors)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fieldIdentifier = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FieldIdentifier(currentEditContext.Model, error.Key);
                messageStore.Add(fieldIdentifier, error.Value);
            }
        currentEditContext.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClearErrors()
        {
            messageStore.Clear();
            currentEditContext.NotifyValidationStateChanged();
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u2308da59" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">我们需要注意到，在这个组件里我们同时监听了EditContext的onValidationRequest事件，以及OnFieldChange事件，同时我们使用了一个字段ValidationMessageStore, 主要是用于验证的消息保存，另外我们使用DisplayErrors 收集来自组件的错误信息，同时使用EditContext通知订阅了事件ValidationStateChanged的接收者。</span></p>
<p id="ucd8572d2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">然后我们在EditForm里应用该组件，代码如下：</span></p>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> ismarried { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">是否婚配</span>

        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ToString()
        {

            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">姓名：{name}，年龄：{age},生日：{birthday},城市：{city}，是否婚配：{ismarried}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

        }

    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> student stu = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> student() { };

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomValidator customValidator;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ValidationMessageStore messageStore;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HandleValidSubmit()
    {
        customValidator.ClearErrors();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> errors = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stu.name == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            errors.Add(nameof(stu.name), </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">姓名不能为 admin</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (stu.age &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">18</span> || stu.age &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            errors.Add(nameof(stu.age), </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">年龄必须在 18 到 60 岁之间</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (errors.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            customValidator.DisplayErrors(errors);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">表单提交成功:{stu.ToString()}！</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);            
        }
    }

}</span></pre>

<div class="lake-content">
<h2 id="BJRif"><span class="ne-text">三、第三方验证库（如 FluentValidation）</span></h2>
<p id="u8638fa78" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在 Blazor 应用中，使用像 <strong><span class="ne-text">FluentValidation</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 这样的第三方库来处理表单验证，可以让你摆脱内置数据注解的限制，更灵活地定义复杂的业务验证规则。社区提供了诸如 <strong><span class="ne-text">Blazored.FluentValidation</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 这样的库来简化集成工作。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 id="oHOuv"><span class="ne-text">1. 安装 NuGet 包</span></h3>
<p id="uf84dc31e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">根据你选择的 FluentValidation Blazor 集成库，在项目目录下执行安装命令，或者手动打开管理NuGet程序包，搜索安装。例如，使用 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text"> Blazored.FluentValidation</span></code>包：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dotnet add package FluentValidation
dotnet add package Blazored.FluentValidation</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="wLrYq"><span class="ne-text">2. 创建模型与验证器</span></h3>
<p id="u02880ad4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">创建一个数据模型（例如 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">User</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 类）和对应的验证器类。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模型类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Email { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证器类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FluentValidation;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> UserValidator : AbstractValidator&lt;User&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserValidator()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义验证规则</span>
        RuleFor(user =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Name)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">姓名不能为空。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 非空验证</span>
            .MaximumLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>).WithMessage(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">姓名长度不能超过10个字符。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最大长度验证</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        RuleFor(user </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> user.Email)
            .NotEmpty().WithMessage(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">邮箱地址不能为空。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .EmailAddress().WithMessage(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请输入有效的邮箱地址。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 邮箱格式验证</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="OSLMW"><span class="ne-text">3. 注册验证器服务</span></h3>
<p id="ub2d37fba" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Program.cs</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 文件中，将你的自定义验证器注册到依赖注入容器中。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FluentValidation;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ... 其他服务配置</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
builder.Services.AddTransient</span>&lt;IValidator&lt;User&gt;, UserValidator&gt;();</pre>
</div>
<div class="lake-content">
<h3 id="K1yrM"><span class="ne-text">4. 在 Blazor 组件中使用</span></h3>
<p id="ud877ca9c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在你的 Razor 组件（<code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">.razor</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 文件）中，使用 <code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">&lt;FluentValidationValidator&gt;</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 组件来启用 FluentValidation。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@page <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">/user-form</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@using BlazorApp.Data  </span>&lt;!-- 根据实际使用的库引入命名空间 --&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@using Blazored.FluentValidation
@using FluentValidation

</span>&lt;EditForm Model=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> OnValidSubmit=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HandleValidSubmit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
    &lt;!-- 使用 FluentValidation 验证器 --&gt;
    &lt;FluentValidationValidator /&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;姓名：&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;InputText id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user.Name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-control</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
        &lt;!-- 显示该字段的验证消息 --&gt;
        &lt;ValidationMessage For=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@(() =&gt; user.Name)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;div <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;
        &lt;label <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;邮箱：&lt;/label&gt;
        &lt;InputText id=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> @bind-Value=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user.Email</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">form-control</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
        &lt;ValidationMessage For=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@(() =&gt; user.Email)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;button type=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">submit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">btn btn-primary</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>&gt;提交&lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;!-- 显示验证摘要 --&gt;
    &lt;ValidationSummary /&gt;
&lt;/EditForm&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

@code {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> User user = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> HandleValidSubmit()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当表单通过所有验证时，会执行此方法</span>
        Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">提交用户：{user.Name}, {user.Email}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里可以添加提交数据到服务器的逻辑</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;以上就是《ASP.NET Core Blazor 核心功能二：Blazor表单和验证》的全部内容，希望你有所收获。<strong>关注、点赞，持续分享</strong>。&nbsp;</p>
